Title: Muddles, Blood Siege and Reprint of SW Questions

Messages.Author: Ramsteiner
Messages.Body:
A few questions have come up recently.

Muddled Vampire Hunter - The text states that it does 4 Damage. I am
assuming that this damage is NOT considered hand damage. So if a
Muddled Vampire Hunter were to get into a combat and have Immortal
Grapple played on it by the opposing minion, it would strike for 0
damage as the 4 Damage is not hand damage. Is this correct?

Blood Siege - While the card text states that no modifiers can be used
during the vote, what about prior to the vote? In short, can the vote
be made an automatic success through the use of Malkavian Cryptic
Rider, Cryptic Rider or Charming Lobby? From what I can gather, the
answer is "yes", however, it seems a bit heavy handed to have that type
of capability exist for one sect but not the other. What is the answer
on this?

If there is a second print of SW (and I certainly hope it occurs), will
many of the cards (both minion and library) within the Demo decks be
included in the Booster sets? (Like the Prince of New York or Blood
Dolls...) Just curious.

Michael Eichler
Prince of Ramstein

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Ramsteiner wrote:
> Muddled Vampire Hunter - The text states that it does 4 Damage. I am
> assuming that this damage is NOT considered hand damage. So if a

His innate, non-ranged, damage-dealing strike is a hand strike, by
definition. The official card text incorporates this ruling (see the
online card text).

> Muddled Vampire Hunter were to get into a combat and have Immortal
> Grapple played on it by the opposing minion, it would strike for 0
> damage as the 4 Damage is not hand damage. Is this correct?

No. He would strike: hands for 4.

> Blood Siege - While the card text states that no modifiers can be used
> during the vote, what about prior to the vote? In short, can the vote
> be made an automatic success through the use of Malkavian Cryptic
> Rider, Cryptic Rider or Charming Lobby? From what I can gather, the
> answer is "yes", however, it seems a bit heavy handed to have that type
> of capability exist for one sect but not the other. What is the answer
> on this?

Malkavian Rider Clause is not an action modifier, so is not affected.
Cryptic Rider cannot be played on the Blood Siege, but one played
previously will cause the referendum to pass automatically.
Charming Lobby is not a modifier, so is not affected.

> If there is a second print of SW (and I certainly hope it occurs), will
> many of the cards (both minion and library) within the Demo decks be
> included in the Booster sets? (Like the Prince of New York or Blood
> Dolls...) Just curious.

?
Then it wouldn't be SW.
It would be a new set, with many reprints from SW.
